subject: Platform PM & Compute ownership proposal — leadership review
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia@ellis-consulting.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Platform PM & Infra Eng alignment (for leadership review)

Grace — attaching a concise proposal for how we could align Product Platform PMs and Compute/Infra engineering to reduce handoffs and clarify ownership. TL;DR: move Platform PMs to report into Platform Eng lead for product-operational alignment, and consolidate Infra Eng + Serving Runtime into a single "Compute" org with two pods (Runtime + Ops).

Why this:
- Repeated friction when launching infra-facing features (model routing, cache plumbing) because PMs are split across Product and Eng.
- Faster incident-to-rollout loop if feature owners sit in the same chain as runtime engineering.
- Cost/latency optimizations need tighter product-eng iteration.

Proposed items (high level):
1) Reporting changes: Platform PMs -> Platform Eng (matrix for career path & PM craft remains with Product).
2) Org shape: Infra Eng + Serving Runtime -> "Platform Compute" with two pods; Marcus to lead compute org.
3) Performance review timing: keep current review cycle but freeze role-level changes until we finalize scope mapping; changes to manager for payroll/comp will be handled by People Ops with an overlap window.
4) Comms: proposed internal comm note + manager talking points attached.

Attachments: org_chart_v2.pptx; comm_note_draft.md (draft); I've also shared a short doc with Ellis Consulting for neutral feedback (cc'd Sofia).

Asks: please review and flag any hard blockers by EOD Thu (24 Jun). If ok, Lauren—can we take this to People Ops and agree a go/no-go date?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Product — Platform
Redwood Inference

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Platform PM & Infra Eng alignment (for leadership review)

Aditya — thanks for the clear draft. A few quick concerns I want addressed before we loop People Ops broadly: 

- PM craft & career implications: moving reporting lines risks muddying PM execution expectations. We need a clear playbook for PM career ladders and promotion criteria post-change.
- Performance reviews: we should not change managers in the middle of an active review window. If we have to, define exactly which cycle people are evaluated under which manager and how calibration happens.
- Compensation/level equivalence: Laura, can you run a quick mapping of current compensation bands for impacted PMs/ICs and surface any anomalies?

Also please add a proposed comm timeline: manager sync -> skip-level Q&A -> org-wide note. I don't want surprises.

If we can get a mapping of role-to-role changes and a two-week "do-not-interrupt" window for reviews, I'm ok taking this to People Ops for an initial operational feasibility check.

Adding a few tactical items and a first-pass comms snippet. I'm attaching a transition checklist and a comm draft with manager talking points. Highlights: 

- Transition checklist (attached): role mapping table, owners for knowledge transfer, critical docs to move (SLA playbooks, on-call runbooks), suggested overlap weeks (2-4 weeks depending on role).
- Comms snippet (attached): short manager note + FAQ. I recommend a manager-only sync first, then a recorded all-hands.
- Risk: support load for SRE during migration — propose temporary 0.5 FTE backfill for the first 6 weeks.

If folks are aligned on the checklist I can run the manager sync invite and seed the agenda.
